scripts.dev:all: pnpm infra:up && pnpm db:setup && concurrently -n api,web,worker,ai-svc,ai-worker,studio -c auto "pnpm --filter @logix/api dev" "pnpm --filter @logix/web dev" "pnpm --filter @logix/business-worker dev" "cd apps/ai-service && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8001" "cd workers/ai-worker && uv run python worker.py" "prisma studio --port 5555 --browser none"
scripts.infra:up: docker compose up -d --wait postgres && docker compose up -d temporal temporal-ui
scripts.db:setup: pnpm db:generate && pnpm db:migrate && pnpm db:seed
scripts.lint: eslint scripts eslint.config.js && turbo run lint
scripts.lint:fix: eslint scripts eslint.config.js --fix && turbo run lint:fix
scripts.validate: pnpm repo:check && pnpm contract:check && pnpm contract:drift && pnpm db:generate && pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm test:e2e && pnpm build
